release.declaration:
(set! (.-fromArrays PersistentHashMap)
  (fn [ks vs]
    (let [len (alength ks)]
      (loop [i 0 ^not-native out (transient (.-EMPTY PersistentHashMap))]
        (if (< i len)
          (if (<= (alength vs) i)
            (throw (js/Error. (str_ "No value supplied for key: " (aget ks i))))
            (recur (inc i) (-assoc! out (aget ks i) (aget vs i))))
          (persistent! out))))))
